Name: qryClientBudgetSummary
Sql:
SELECT c.ClientID, c.LastName & ", " & c.FirstName AS ClientName, cb.FiscalYear, cb.AnnualBudget, Nz((SELECT SUM(csp2.AnnualEstCost) FROM tblClientServicePlan AS csp2 INNER JOIN tblClientServiceNeeds AS csn2 ON csp2.ClientServiceNeedID = csn2.ClientServiceNeedID WHERE csn2.ClientID = c.ClientID AND csp2.FiscalYear = cb.FiscalYear),0) AS TotalPlannedCost, [cb].[AnnualBudget]-Nz((SELECT SUM(csp3.AnnualEstCost) FROM tblClientServicePlan AS csp3 INNER JOIN tblClientServiceNeeds AS csn3 ON csp3.ClientServiceNeedID = csn3.ClientServiceNeedID WHERE csn3.ClientID = c.ClientID AND csp3.FiscalYear = cb.FiscalYear),0) AS RemainingBudget
FROM tblClients AS c INNER JOIN tblClientBudgets AS cb ON c.ClientID = cb.ClientID;
